deterministicTests: test -f trunc.db && test -x "$(command -v python3)" && test "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = /app
acceptanceCriteria: The unchanged external Harbor verifier passes and recover.json contains the required recovered rows in the documented JSON shape.
The supplied truncated database remains available as the immutable task input.
riskNotes: This is a local workspace-compatible derivative of terminal-bench@2.0; only environment/Dockerfile adds Git and commits trunc.db as the clean baseline.
The deterministic command is a public input/tool/Git-root invariant and is not a substitute for the external verifier.
The database is treated as task input; no solution or hidden expected output was inspected during preparation.
allowLocalCommit is false; commits, pushes, merges, deploys, and external mutation remain forbidden.

sourceProvenance.sourceRevision: terminal-bench@2.0 (local extracted source; upstream commit not present)
sourceProvenance.canonicalDigestRule: sorted relative path + TAB + file SHA-256 + LF over all files
